verdict.rationale: Filee's own watch folders are a documented event-triggered rule: a file landing in a folder automatically triggers conversion and can move the originals aside, with per-file-type presets defining the action. The evidence shows only this one trigger type and a narrow action set, not a general rule engine. Missing for 10: event types beyond folder arrival, conditional or user-defined rule logic, actions beyond convert/move, depth documentation of watch-folder configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Watch folders automatically convert the files that land in a folder and can move the originals aside.
Presets per file type: quality, resizing, rotate and flip, DPI, grayscale, metadata, background removal, Trace to SVG
